heading_en: Notification of Changes Regarding Trading Desks by Ultimate Designated Parent Companies Adopting the Standardized Method
summary_ja: 標準的方式採用最終指定親会社の変更届出義務と、要件を満たさなくなった場合の改善計画等の提出を定める。
summary_en: Requires an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method to notify changes without delay and to submit an improvement plan or a materiality explanation where a desk ceases to meet the requirements.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method that has submitted the notification under the preceding Article shall, where any of the following items applies, submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency without delay a notification of change stating that fact and its details. (i) Where there has been a change in the matters stated in the notification. (ii) Where there has been a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the notification. (iii) Where grounds have arisen by reason of which the trading desk does not satisfy the requirements listed in the items of Article 249-3, paragraph (3) (excluding item (x)(b)).

Where grounds prescribed in item (iii) of the preceding paragraph have arisen, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method shall promptly submit either a document stating an improvement plan regarding those grounds or a document stating an explanation that those grounds are not material from the viewpoint of the risk of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method.
